newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pokka sees difficult year ahead.
newsitem.headline: Pokka sees difficult year ahead.

text.p: Pokka Corp (Singapore) Ltd said on Friday it expected market conditions to remain highly competitive and difficult in the drinks manufacturing business this year.

In a statement accompanying its 1996 results, Pokka said the company's sales to China would continue to shrink as the sales would be taken over by an associated company in Suzhou, which is expected to begin operations in May.
The restaurant business was expected to continue to make positive contributions, the statement said.
Pokka posted a net loss of Singapore $2.13 million at the group level for the year ended January 31, 1997.
